info.title: Brai Hermes identity broker
info.description: Unix JSON-RPC 2.0, one UTF-8 NDJSON frame per connection; singleton or sequential batch of 1..16 requests. Notifications produce no response. SO_PEERCRED chooses caller role for every batch item. Frame at most 2 MiB, 32 concurrently admitted connections; control pending at most 32. Initial frame deadline 5s; authorization 3s, bootstrap/configuration 35s, file operations 1800s. Disconnect/timeout does not prove cancellation; no automatic mutation replay. Worker methods reject uid/owner parameters. See ../files/CONTRACT.md for stable inode, root snapshot, per-user cache and read-only ingress FD transport and legacy ingress-copy compatibility requirements. Login delivery requires loginDeliveryStatePath: root-owned regular SQLite file mode 0600 inside root-owned parent directories without group/other write. Broker creates a missing database mode 0600; existing unsafe files or symlink paths are rejected. maxLoginReceipts defaults to 1000000, can be raised by operator, and never evicts existing receipts. ingress.open-artifact is a single request with id on this socket: result <=32 KiB plus exactly one SCM_RIGHTS O_RDONLY FD, no paths/credentials. Root peer and ingress UID must be verified. Deadline 120s; response write 5s. Notifications receive no FD; batch use is unavailable (-32001). No directory access or extra delivery copy; no fallback to legacy copying.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Root-only admission check; user and profile must remain active.

methods.name: identity.resolve
methods.description: Только trusted ingress. telegramId в результате — фактический связанный аккаунт запроса; authorTelegramId — стабильный автор UID-профиля. Отвязанный аккаунт не проходит свежий Auth.

methods.name: identity.invite-redeem
methods.description: Trusted ingress-only invitation provisioning. Unknown outcome must be reconciled without blind replay.

methods.name: ingress.admit
methods.description: Register trusted Telegram route/turn/input before user RPC. inputId is SHA-256 of actual message identity and current text/media/timestamp supplied only by ingress, never by model. Same input preserves request/outcome; a new actual input resets login suppression and uses a distinct stable login requestId. Legacy omission is scoped to turnId. Competing active turn/binding is rejected.

schema.description: Тема исходного личного Telegram запроса; задаётся только доверенным ingress.

params.name: expectedUid
params.description: Trusted ingress pins the resolved worker UID before admission; alias rebinding must fail before reserving another owner turn.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Trusted original Telegram message ID. Confirmation requires a strictly later message than the delivered offer; editing an old message cannot confirm.

params.name: accountRefused
params.description: Trusted ingress recognizes an explicit refusal in the actual new message; never accepted from model.

params.name: accountAnswer
params.description: Full original human text from trusted ingress only, not a model authorization flag. Answers longer than8192 are ineligible, never truncated. Kept only in the active turn.

methods.name: ingress.status
methods.description: Trusted ingress-only status of a registered active owner turn.

params.name: inputId
params.description: Trusted current input identity. Any change rejects a stale status/close; required to grant delivered consent.

methods.name: ingress.close
methods.description: Trusted ingress-only release of the exact registered turn.

params.name: questionMessageId
params.description: Trusted ingress receipt of fully delivered final agent question; maximum of all split message IDs. Broker also retains original human ID as a lower bound.

params.name: inputId
params.description: Trusted current input identity. Any change rejects a stale status/close; required to grant delivered consent.

params.name: accountOfferId
params.description: Opaque root-issued offer from ingress.status; required together with inputId to bind question delivery to that exact offer. Stale receipts close without granting consent.

methods.name: ingress.prepare
methods.description: Trusted ingress-only. Copy stable files owned by ingressUid from configured ingressReadRoots into selected owner home/media. Paths must belong to the registered uid/turnId; worker cannot call.

methods.name: ingress.artifact
methods.description: Trusted ingress-only. Recheck Artifacts owner and copy verified bytes into ingressDeliveryRoot/<uid>-<artifactId>/<filename>; original root cache path and permissions remain private.

methods.name: tools.list
methods.description: Worker catalog bound to SO_PEERCRED; owner cannot be supplied.

methods.name: tools.call
methods.description: Worker tool call bound to SO_PEERCRED. publish_file/fetch_file use dedicated bounded files ports.

methods.name: ingress.profiles
methods.description: Only trusted ingress UID; returns active registry profiles after fresh Auth authorization, without transcripts or credentials. Used for persistent worker supervision.

methods.name: ingress.delivery-artifact
methods.description: Только trusted ingress. Свежий Auth проверяет стабильного владельца UID; выдача owner-bound bytes для отдельно проверенного маршрута proactive/UI доставки, без требования входящего turn.

methods.name: files.configuration
methods.description: Worker bootstrap only. UID from SO_PEERCRED and root-owned runtime mapping must match registry userId/profileId/home. Active profiles require current Auth. Provisioning profiles may receive only their nonsecret own configuration before startup health/activation; all data and tools remain denied. Blocked/disabled profiles are denied. Private data roots are home/workspace/files and home/results; secrets are absent.

methods.name: files.publish
methods.description: Worker-only root snapshot publication. Exact params path/requestId, no uid/owner. Source must be a stable regular single-link inode owned by worker in home/{workspace,results,media}; at most 64 MiB. Result localPath/markdown point to a verified home/results copy. Same requestId preserves Artifacts idempotency; no transport retries.

methods.name: artifacts.publish
methods.description: Worker-only root snapshot publication. Exact params path/requestId, no uid/owner. Source must be a stable regular single-link inode owned by worker in home/{workspace,results,media}; at most 64 MiB. Result localPath/markdown point to a verified home/results copy. Same requestId preserves Artifacts idempotency; no transport retries.

methods.name: files.fetch
methods.description: Worker-only owner/ready validation and verified cache copy to home/results. Never returns the root publisher path.

methods.name: artifacts.fetch
methods.description: Worker-only owner/ready validation and verified cache copy to home/results. Never returns the root publisher path.

methods.name: files.get
methods.description: Worker-only current-owner Artifacts metadata; ownerId and internalUrl omitted.

methods.name: files.list
methods.description: Worker-only ready artifacts of the current owner; ownerId and internalUrl omitted.

methods.name: files.prepare
methods.description: Worker-only owner validation of every ordered item. Preserves duplicate artifact IDs, captions and delivery mode.

methods.name: login.send
methods.description: Worker-only code delivery for the currently registered private trusted input. Serialized per UID; root-only SQLite loginDeliveryStatePath persists unknown in a FULL synchronous commit before control/Telegram write and stores only requestId/outcome. Replay, timeout, cancellation, crash, close/reopen or restart never re-send the same recorded input. New real input uses a new stable requestId and Auth invalidates the prior code. Late completion cannot suppress a newer input. maxLoginReceipts defaults to 1000000; capacity blocks new login attempts without evicting old receipts or blocking ordinary input admission. No code or user text is stored or returned.

methods.name: identity.link-redeem
methods.description: Trusted ingress only. Personal Telegram account linking; never available to the model. No automatic mutation retry.

methods.name: telegram.link
methods.description: Agent writes its warning and interprets the next explicit human permission. Broker verifies exact full-text confirmation from trusted ingress, fresh delivered question, same account/topic and pinned action/target. Any later human input or new offer invalidates the old answer. No automatic mutation retry; secrets never enter the model.

params.name: message
params.description: Agent introduction after fresh consent; plain text without links, mentions or /start. Delivery appends the verified current bot URL.

params.name: confirmation
params.description: After a delivered warning, the agent interprets a new explicit permission and copies the full original human answer exactly. No trimming, paraphrase or substring. Broker verifies provenance/freshness/action/target/TTL; semantic interpretation remains the agent responsibility. Omission starts a NEW read-only offer and invalidates any earlier answer.

methods.name: telegram.unlink
methods.description: Agent writes its warning and interprets the next explicit human permission. Broker verifies exact full-text confirmation from trusted ingress, fresh delivered question, same account/topic and pinned action/target. Any later human input or new offer invalidates the old answer. No automatic mutation retry; secrets never enter the model.

methods.name: dialogues.authorize
methods.description: Служебный UID из SO_PEERCRED; актуальный Auth, без аргументов владельца.

methods.name: dialogues.summarize-stream
methods.description: Только служебный UID. Двунаправленный NDJSON: сервер ready или busy; клиент кадры {id,text}, затем {id,end:true}; сервер chunk с byte offset и completed с totalBytes/SHA-256. До 65536 байт на кадр, один поток суммаризации, deadline 170 секунд, backpressure. Полный input/result остаётся только в персональном процессе и модельном контейнере с memory=256MiB. Общий root broker держит ограниченные буферы; весь поток в памяти не собирает.

methods.name: ingress.open-artifact
methods.description: Trusted ingress-only read capability for one owner-bound ready artifact. Auth and optional current turn/input/account binding are checked again after fetch. The descriptor is pinned and verified, O_RDONLY, non-inheritable at the receiver. Release on success/error/cancellation. Revocation denies new grants but cannot revoke bytes or an already granted FD. Caller may not provide owner, path or storage credentials. See WORKER.md.

methods.name: native.catalog
methods.description: Проверка имени только для discovery подготовленного каталога; не выдаёт право исполнения.

methods.name: backup.status
methods.description: Worker UID is authenticated via SO_PEERCRED and current Auth. Only admin/creator; role, owner, path and command arguments are forbidden. Run queues the fixed root-only systemd job; it does not mean cloud success. No automatic replay after unknown outcome.

methods.name: backup.run
methods.description: Worker UID is authenticated via SO_PEERCRED and current Auth. Only admin/creator; role, owner, path and command arguments are forbidden. Run queues the fixed root-only systemd job; it does not mean cloud success. No automatic replay after unknown outcome.
